reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1 skipped (missing-validation finding; additionally pre_liquidation_check has 3 non-test callers). Gate 2 skipped (no trust_assumptions in BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json). Gate 3 passed (liquidate.move is explicitly in-scope; liquidation logic is a focus area). Spec deviation confirmed: no liquidator != borrower check exists anywhere in the liquidation call chain (pre_liquidation_check, handle_liquidation, liquidation_inner). Verdict is CONFIRMED_POTENTIAL rather than CONFIRMED_VULNERABILITY because the attack path requires a PackageCallerCap (admin-whitelisted credential), making exploitation conditional on the attacker holding or compromising a whitelisted operator position. An attacker who holds a PackageCallerCap and also controls a borrowing obligation can call liquidate_as_coin() with their own obligation_id, receiving seized_collateral > repaid_debt (by the liquidation incentive) at no economic penalty.
